title: Grilled Skewers with Hot and Charred Flair
description: Experience a bold and exotic Venezuelan-inspired dish with the deep, smoky flavors of grilled hot peppers and charred onions.
instructions: Soak the skewers in water for at least 30 minutes before grilling.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (400°F/200°C).
Thread the hot peppers, onions, zucchini, and bell peppers onto the skewers.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
While the skewers are grilling, cook the shirataki noodles according to package instructions.
Once the skewers are cooked, brush with soy sauce and serve with shirataki noodles.
Garnish with additional hot peppers and onions if desired.
